effect_size_edges.mask_learning: diagnosis-by-sex stratified discovery AD/Control donors only

lioness_network.functional: Pearson signedAlt with frozen block-specific powers
lioness_network.note: LIONESS is distinct from the M5 partition and M5 group-MDC functional.

mdc.note: Directional FDR is the conservative maximum of component- and direction-specific BH values from the sample and tissue-count-preserving gene nulls.

notes: Fixed all-donor modules; discovery-selection bias is not corrected.
Each donor's gene and tissue expression profile is preserved; only diagnosis membership is permuted.
Label-dependent M5 bootstrap and CT calibration are rebuilt; no q90 scaling or clipping.
Two-sided equal-tail plus-one label-permutation p; BH across valid modules separately by weighting and scope.
Primary CT–TS contrast uses unpowered correlations. M5 contrast is weighting-dependent sensitivity.
Balanced results describe repeated AD subsampling to 120; 2.5/97.5 percentiles are not inferential confidence intervals.
Existing disrupted-coexpression/gene-set null FDRs are retained and not reused here.
mdc_label_validation.strata: study × sex; exact within-stratum counts for label permutations

notes: Identical beta values are used in AD and Control for every corresponding variant and tissue block.
Low powers are beta_TS=3 and beta_CT=2; M5 variants retain bootstrap stability and group-specific CT null-excess calibration.
Shared scale means Control-derived block q90 applied identically to both groups. It is refitted from the Control network within each permutation.
The sample null independently permutes donors within genes and rebuilds all affected network terms; the gene null preserves tissue counts.
FDR is computed separately by variant, scope and direction across valid modules; it requires support from both nulls.
Modules were discovered in the all-donor cohort. These sensitivities remain conditional on the fixed module definition and do not remove discovery selection dependence.
No existing MDC, LIONESS or prediction result is replaced.
